t.why: Iraq invaded it in 1990, and a US-led coalition liberated it.
t.rel: Because Iraq to the north invaded it, border and missing-persons issues lingered for a long time. It is close to Saudi Arabia through the Gulf Cooperation Council and disagrees with Iran over the boundary of an offshore gas field.
t.korea: A major supplier of crude oil to Korea.
t.know: The Kuwaiti dinar is the world's highest-valued currency.
t.etext: Oil makes up most exports and government revenue. It runs the world's oldest sovereign wealth fund. Most citizens work in the public sector.
